selection_basis: Posthoc development ablation motivated by the already observed P1 double-column interleaving. No ground-truth text or boxes used to choose geometric thresholds. Parameters fixed before calculating any reordered CER.
anchor_band_policy: Merge overlapping crossing-block bands, absorb vertically overlapping side blocks, then preserve geometric row order inside each anchor band. Between bands, read left column completely before right column.
fallback: Preserve exact original block order when geometry is invalid, missing or fails the two-column gate.
text_policy: Only reorder existing OCR line blocks; no character correction, translation, dropping, deduplication, or caption generation.
promotion: No production promotion; scores are development observations only. Three variants of one source page are paired observations, not independent sources.
